slices.title: Characterisation goldens and ledger entries
slices.summary: Pins the Do tool catalogue (each offered tool with trusted_capability_id, rung_required_for and is_risky_tool) and the 8 model-eligible ids as golden tests, records the DEC-24 and DEC-25 decisions and the never-promote rule in the decisions ledger, and corrects the stale workspace_hydrate.rs header. Docs and tests only; no runtime change.
test_commands: cd "apps/Frontend Plane/verevonv3" && pnpm vitest run src/shared/actions

slices.title: Content version and surfaced upload failure
slices.summary: Defines the workspace content version as the sha256 of the redacted bytes, equal to the CAS put hash, and makes an upload or snapshot failure visible: upload_and_discard_workspace returns WorkspaceUploadOutcome with uploaded=false, a workspace_upload_failed counter increments, and the run summary says the workspace changes were not saved. Counters only; no new persistence.
slices.needs_external: WS22 session agreement on the per-step Space write-through reconcile (the plan settles it by DEC-24)
test_commands: cd "apps/Model Plane/rust" && cargo test -q -p execution-core --lib workspace_hydrate sandbox_lease

slices.title: Workspace edit engine as pure functions
slices.summary: Adds execution-core workspace_edit.rs with read, grep, glob, list, edit and put under a canonical root: sha256 version tokens, closed EditError codes, EOL, BOM and mode preservation, a 1 MiB edit cap and atomic temp-plus-rename writes, plus a per-workspace RwLock on HydratedWorkspace. Pure file operations with no network, gRPC, sandbox lease or tool bridge.
test_commands: cd "apps/Model Plane/rust" && cargo test -q -p execution-core --lib workspace_edit && cargo test -q -p execution-core --test workspace_edit_contract

slices.title: Read-only workspace tools behind WORKSPACE_TOOLS
slices.summary: Adds four read tools (workspace_read, workspace_grep, workspace_glob, workspace_list) offered only to Space-scoped runs that are not ZDR or waived, when WORKSPACE_TOOLS is read or all. They dispatch through the signed capability gate as cap.workspace.read (migration 0018), which must be advertised, bound, seeded and attested. Off by default in code and compose.
slices.flag: WORKSPACE_TOOLS=off|read|all (execution-core env; default off in code and compose; read then all on the proof stack)
slices.needs_external: integrator assigns the capability-core migration number at merge (DEC-39; 0018 is the plan's 4.4 reservation)
test_commands: cd "apps/Model Plane/go/services/capability-core" && go test ./... && go vet ./... && go test -tags integration ./internal/registry/...

slices.title: Workspace write tools as per-run overlay
slices.summary: Adds workspace_edit and workspace_put as per-run overlay writes offered only when WORKSPACE_TOOLS=all. The write arms take the exclusive workspace lock (the code_interpreter and process arms take it around their execution), they are refused in plan mode and leaf subagents, and they return durability run_overlay with a reminder that other runs do not see the change. They dispatch as cap.workspace.write (migration 0019, a separate row so an org can disable writes and keep reads), with no per-call approval, matching save_memory.
slices.flag: WORKSPACE_TOOLS=all (the same switch as S3; the write arms are offered only in mode all)
slices.needs_external: owner acceptance of DEC-24 D1 (overlay visibility, explicit accept under F-t3-076) and D2 (rung), and DEC-10 (OD2), before WORKSPACE_TOOLS=all reaches the product route; integrator assigns the migration number (DEC-39)
test_commands: cd "apps/Model Plane/go/services/capability-core" && go test ./... && go vet ./... && go test -tags integration ./internal/registry/...

slices.title: Model access classification and contract
slices.summary: Makes the frontend action registry's model access exhaustive: a typed model-access.ts (none, read or write_approval; a closed exempt-reason set; executor declarations) derives the 8-id eligibility set, catalog-manifest moves to schema version 3 with modelAccess, exemptReason, sideEffectClass and schemaHash, and a canonical agent-action-admission.json is vendored to the Rust, Go and frontend trees. action-registry.ts is not edited and no runtime behaviour changes.
test_commands: cd "apps/Frontend Plane/verevonv3" && pnpm vitest run src/shared/actions src/shared/context-packs && pnpm typecheck && pnpm lint
cd "apps/Model Plane/rust" && cargo test -q -p execution-core --test agent_action_admission_contract
cd "apps/Model Plane/rust" && cargo test -q -p model-gateway --lib every_ask_read

slices.title: Agent action admissions table and pinned owner actions
slices.summary: Adds a capability-core agent_action_admissions table (status enabled, declared or retired) behind MODEL_ACTION_ADMISSION, served as a signed model-action-view-v2 beside v1, with tickets.create byte-identical under tickets_only. Execution-core admits a server-resolved owner action only when OWNER_ACTION_PINS pins its name, schema hash, parameters and adapter (new owner_actions.rs). Per K3-25 a table row alone admits nothing: the pin and the owner verifier are also required.
slices.flag: MODEL_ACTION_ADMISSION=tickets_only|table (capability-core and execution-core; default tickets_only, table on the proof stack)
slices.needs_external: integrator assigns the capability-core migration number at merge (DEC-39; 0022 is the plan's 4.4 reservation); the WS13 approval floor must exist before write_approval rows are admitted
test_commands: cd "apps/Model Plane/rust" && cargo test -q -p execution-core --lib owner_actions

slices.title: Control run-action target table and view v2
slices.summary: Replaces the switch in runActionTarget with a user-core run_action_targets table (action_id, service_audience, permission, class, hash_basis, schema_hash) seeded with tickets.create only. The model-action view request takes optional action ids, intersected with the table and with agent entitlement (a read-class action needs no write entitlement), and the capability-core verifier accepts v2. Per K3-25 a row alone admits nothing: each new action also needs an OWNER_ACTION_PINS entry and an owner verifier.
slices.needs_external: Control Plane owner review of the user-core edits (one owner per PR); integrator assigns the migration number (DEC-39; 031 is the plan's 4.4 reservation); the migration is skipped if control-signed reads are deferred

slices.title: Owner read knowledge.list_documents in Do
slices.summary: Adds the owner read knowledge.list_documents to the Do loop: a new owner_reads.rs calls Data Plane DocumentService ListDocuments with the run's delegated user bearer (the same bearer execute_knowledge_search uses) and returns at most 25 rows of document_id, title, source, type and status with no content. It is offered only when MODEL_ACTION_ADMISSION=table, the admission row is enabled and the run is not ZDR. The model-access row gains its do executor and the contract is regenerated in every copy.
slices.needs_external: Data Plane owner confirmation that ListDocuments accepts the forwarded delegated bearer exactly as the gateway retrieval authorize step does (not determined in the plan; the proof settles it)
test_commands: cd "apps/Model Plane/rust" && cargo test -q -p execution-core --lib owner_reads

slices.title: Proofs, ZDR matrix rows and ownership docs
slices.summary: Adds workspace-tools-proof.sh and agent-action-admission-proof.sh, modelled on tickets-create-proof.sh with a disposable Postgres and no credential creation. Adds the ZDR posture-matrix rows workspace_tools_under_zdr_not_offered_not_executed, owner_actions_under_zdr_not_offered and owner_reads_under_zdr_not_offered with their vendored copies, adds the workspace_tools refusal key, records the ledger and capability-ownership rows, and makes CI run the two new contract tests. Proofs run only on rebuilt images, with flags flipped on the proof stack only.
